column1: # Resolutions of live swaps on the test laptop (pipeline/swaps.py). One line per swapped file:

# "row"/"recipe": the fix now ships in images that way. "dropped": the swap was an experiment not to keep.
# hao-runtime files under /usr/lib/hao/ need no line when the hao_runtime row's payload has the same bytes.
